solution_summary: Dovetail Enhances Customer Insights with New Generative AI Products Developed in Weeks Using Amazon Bedrock Dovetail is a global B2B SaaS company whose products help teams leverage customer insights. To improve scalability and automate data processing and analysis, Dovetail sought to leverage large language models (LLMs) and build its generative AI capabilities. By adopting Amazon Bedrock, Dovetail can now create prototypes within a day and release new generative AI products and features in just two weeks. Building on AWS ensures Dovetail maintains data security, residency, and low latency while delivering intuitive AI-driven tools that enhance customer insights. When AWS introduced Amazon Bedrock , a fully managed service offering a range of high-performing foundation models, Dovetail was invited to join the service preview cohort. Source data is ingested through Amazon Transcribe, processed with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker.
